                    阅读5分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><h2 data-id="heading-0">不要再用 removeEventListener了！这个API救了我的命</h2>
<p>昨天被产品经理叫到办公室，说用户反馈我们的后台管理系统越用越卡，Chrome任务管理器显示内存占用已经飙到2GB了。我tm当场就懵了，这不是在打我脸吗？</p>
<p>回到工位一番排查，发现罪魁祸首竟然是那些没清理干净的事件监听器。看着满屏的<code>addEventListener</code>和对应的清理代码，我突然想起了之前看到过但一直没用的<code>AbortController</code>。</p>
<p>试了一下，卧槽，真香。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">先看看我写的这坨屎</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// 我之前写的"杰作"，现在看着都想删库跑路</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">DataGrid</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params">container, options</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">container</span> = container;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">options</span> = options;
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 绑定this，一个都不能少，不然就报错</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleResize</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleResize</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">bind</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleScroll</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleScroll</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">bind</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleClick</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleClick</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">bind</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleKeydown</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleKeydown</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">bind</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleContextMenu</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleContextMenu</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">bind</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>);
    
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">init</span>();
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">init</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 事件监听器注册大会</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resize'</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleResize</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">container</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'scroll'</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleScroll</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">container</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleClick</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'keydown'</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleKeydown</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">container</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'contextmenu'</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleContextMenu</span>);
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 还有定时器要管理</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">resizeTimer</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollTimer</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">destroy</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 清理环节，经常漏几个</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resize'</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleResize</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">container</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'scroll'</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleScroll</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">container</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleClick</span>);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'keydown'</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handleKeydown</span>);
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 草，contextmenu忘记清理了</span>
    
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">resizeTimer</span>) <span class="hljs-built_in">clearTimeout</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">resizeTimer</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollTimer</span>) <span class="hljs-built_in">clearTimeout</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scrollTimer</span>);
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>这种写法有多恶心？我来告诉你：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>写到手酸</strong> - 每个方法都得bind一遍，复制粘贴都嫌烦</li>
<li><strong>容易遗漏</strong> - 加了事件监听器，销毁的时候经常忘记清理某几个</li>
<li><strong>维护困难</strong> - 想加个新事件？得在两个地方改代码</li>
</ol>
<p>最要命的是，这个DataGrid会被频繁创建销毁（用户切换页面、筛选数据等），每次忘记清理就是一次内存泄漏。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">AbortController拯救了我的职业生涯</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">DataGrid</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params">container, options</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">container</span> = container;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">options</span> = options;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controller</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>();
    
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">init</span>();
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">init</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { signal } = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controller</span>;
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 所有事件监听器统一管理，爽到飞起</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resize'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-built_in">clearTimeout</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">resizeTimer</span>);
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">resizeTimer</span> = <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">handleResize</span>(e), <span class="hljs-number">200</span>);
    }, { signal });
    
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">container</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'scroll'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">handleScroll</span>(e);
    }, { signal, <span class="hljs-attr">passive</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> });
    
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">container</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">handleClick</span>(e);
    }, { signal });
    
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'keydown'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (e.<span class="hljs-property">key</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'Delete'</span> &amp;&amp; <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">selectedRows</span>.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">deleteSelectedRows</span>();
      }
    }, { signal });
    
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">container</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'contextmenu'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      e.<span class="hljs-title function_">preventDefault</span>();
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">showContextMenu</span>(e);
    }, { signal });
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">destroy</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 一行代码解决所有问题！</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controller</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>();
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>你没看错，destroy方法只需要一行代码。当初看到这个效果时，我特么激动得想发朋友圈。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">线上踩坑记录</h3>
<p>不过用AbortController也不是一帆风顺的。记得刚开始用的时候，我直接这样写：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// 错误示范，别学我</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Modal</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">show</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controller</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { signal } = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controller</span>;
    
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'keydown'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (e.<span class="hljs-property">key</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'Escape'</span>) <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">hide</span>();
    }, { signal });
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">hide</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controller</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>();
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 没有重新创建controller！</span>
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>结果modal第二次打开的时候，ESC键失效了。原因很简单：<code>controller.abort()</code>之后，这个controller就废了，不能重复使用。</p>
<p>正确的写法应该是：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Modal</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controller</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>();
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">show</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setupEvents</span>();
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">setupEvents</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { signal } = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controller</span>;
    
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'keydown'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (e.<span class="hljs-property">key</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'Escape'</span>) <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">hide</span>();
    }, { signal });
    
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (e.<span class="hljs-property">target</span> === <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">overlay</span>) <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">hide</span>();
    }, { signal });
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">hide</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controller</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>();
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 重新创建一个新的controller</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controller</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>();
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">真实项目：拖拽排序的坑</h3>
<p>前段时间做一个看板功能，需要实现卡片拖拽排序。用传统方式写的话，光是事件监听器的管理就能把人逼疯：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">DragSort</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params">container</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">container</span> = container;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">isDragging</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">dragElement</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
    
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">initDrag</span>();
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">initDrag</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> dragController = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>();
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">dragController</span> = dragController;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { signal } = dragController;
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 只在容器上监听mousedown</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">container</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'mousedown'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> card = e.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">closest</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'.card'</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!card) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">startDrag</span>(card, e);
    }, { signal });
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">startDrag</span>(<span class="hljs-params">card, startEvent</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 为每次拖拽创建独立的controller</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> moveController = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { signal } = moveController;
    
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">isDragging</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">dragElement</span> = card;
    
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> startX = startEvent.<span class="hljs-property">clientX</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> startY = startEvent.<span class="hljs-property">clientY</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> rect = card.<span class="hljs-title function_">getBoundingClientRect</span>();
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 创建拖拽副本</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> ghost = card.<span class="hljs-title function_">cloneNode</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">true</span>);
    ghost.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'fixed'</span>;
    ghost.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">left</span> = rect.<span class="hljs-property">left</span> + <span class="hljs-string">'px'</span>;
    ghost.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">top</span> = rect.<span class="hljs-property">top</span> + <span class="hljs-string">'px'</span>;
    ghost.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">pointerEvents</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'none'</span>;
    ghost.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">opacity</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'0.8'</span>;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">body</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">appendChild</span>(ghost);
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 拖拽过程中的事件</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'mousemove'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> deltaX = e.<span class="hljs-property">clientX</span> - startX;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> deltaY = e.<span class="hljs-property">clientY</span> - startY;
      
      ghost.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">left</span> = (rect.<span class="hljs-property">left</span> + deltaX) + <span class="hljs-string">'px'</span>;
      ghost.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">top</span> = (rect.<span class="hljs-property">top</span> + deltaY) + <span class="hljs-string">'px'</span>;
      
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 检测插入位置</span>
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">updateDropIndicator</span>(e);
    }, { signal });
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 拖拽结束</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'mouseup'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">endDrag</span>(ghost);
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 自动清理本次拖拽的所有事件</span>
      moveController.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>();
    }, { signal, <span class="hljs-attr">once</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> });
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 防止文本选中</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'selectstart'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      e.<span class="hljs-title function_">preventDefault</span>();
    }, { signal });
    
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 防止右键菜单</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'contextmenu'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      e.<span class="hljs-title function_">preventDefault</span>();
    }, { signal });
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">destroy</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">dragController</span>?.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>();
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>这种写法的好处是，每次拖拽开始时创建独立的controller，拖拽结束时自动清理相关事件。不会出现事件监听器累积的问题。</p>
<p>以前用传统方式，我得手动管理mousemove和mouseup的清理，经常出现拖拽结束后事件还在监听的bug。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">React项目中的应用</h3>
<p>在React项目里，我封装了一个hook：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { useEffect, useRef } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useEventController</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> controllerRef = <span class="hljs-title function_">useRef</span>();
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    controllerRef.<span class="hljs-property">current</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>();
    
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      controllerRef.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>?.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>();
    };
  }, []);
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">target, event, handler, options = {}</span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!controllerRef.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
    
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> element = target?.<span class="hljs-property">current</span> || target;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!element) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
    
    element.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(event, handler, {
      <span class="hljs-attr">signal</span>: controllerRef.<span class="hljs-property">current</span>.<span class="hljs-property">signal</span>,
      ...options
    });
  };
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> { addEventListener };
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 使用起来贼爽</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">MyComponent</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { addEventListener } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useEventController</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> buttonRef = <span class="hljs-title function_">useRef</span>();
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">useEffect</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'resize'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'窗口大小变了'</span>);
    });
    
    <span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(buttonRef, <span class="hljs-string">'click'</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'按钮被点了'</span>);
    });
  }, []);
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">button</span> <span class="hljs-attr">ref</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{buttonRef}</span>&gt;</span>点我<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">button</span>&gt;</span></span>;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">兼容性和实际使用建议</h3>
<p>AbortController在主流浏览器中支持得还不错，Chrome 66+、Firefox 57+、Safari 11.1+都能用。我们项目的用户主要是企业客户，浏览器版本都比较新，所以直接用了。</p>
<p>如果你需要兼容老浏览器，可以加个简单的判断：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">EventManager</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">useAbortController</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'AbortController'</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>;
    
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">useAbortController</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controller</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>();
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handlers</span> = [];
    }
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">on</span>(<span class="hljs-params">target, event, handler, options = {}</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">useAbortController</span>) {
      target.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(event, handler, {
        <span class="hljs-attr">signal</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controller</span>.<span class="hljs-property">signal</span>,
        ...options
      });
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 降级到传统方式</span>
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handlers</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>({ target, event, handler, options });
      target.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(event, handler, options);
    }
  }
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">destroy</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">useAbortController</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">controller</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>();
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handlers</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">{ target, event, handler, options }</span>) =&gt;</span> {
        target.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(event, handler, options);
      });
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">handlers</span> = [];
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-7">最后</h3>
<p>说实话，AbortController这个API我很早就知道，但一直以为只能用来取消fetch请求。直到那次内存泄漏的事故，我才真正开始研究它的其他用法。</p>
<p>现在回头看，这个API真的改变了我写事件处理代码的方式。代码变得更简洁，bug更少，维护成本也大大降低。</p>
<p>当然，不是说传统的addEventListener就一无是处。在某些需要精确控制单个事件监听器的场景下，传统方式可能还是有必要的。但对于大部分日常开发，AbortController绝对是更好的选择。</p>
<p>如果你也经常被事件监听器的管理搞得头疼，试试这个方法吧。保证你用了就回不去了。</p>
<p>ps：写这篇文章的时候，我又想起了那个2GB内存占用的bug。现在想想，要是早点用AbortController，也不至于被产品经理叫到办公室"喝茶"了。😅</p></div></div>
